title: Why your website gets traffic but no customers
caption: Your website has 3 seconds to prove your business is legit. Run the FAST check on yours today and thank me later.

video.hookLine: is all you get before a visitor decides if your business feels legit or not.
video.credibility: We rebuild websites for a living and these four fixes come up on almost every project.

steps.title: Fast
steps.point: If the page takes longer than 3 seconds, people leave.

steps.title: Answer
steps.point: Kill their objections right on the page. Price, trust, timing.

steps.title: Show
steps.point: Real photos, real reviews. Proof beats promises.

steps.title: Tell
steps.point: One page, one job. Say exactly what to do next.

video.example: One client doubled enquiries by just moving reviews above the fold.
video.ctaQuestion: Does your site pass the FAST check?
video.ctaOffer: Follow for a free site teardown every Friday.
